html:
The map data puts the name "White Russia" on a vast shape that runs from Eastern Europe across Siberia to the Pacific, in 1920 and 1930. That is the land of Soviet Russia, the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic. "White Russia" was normally an old English name for Belarus, so the name is probably a slip in the map data. The map here prints Soviet Russia instead.

Soviet Russia was the state set up by the Bolsheviks after the Russian Revolution of 1917, under Lenin. In 1920 it was still fighting the Russian Civil War against the anti-communist White armies, and the country was ruined. The famine of 1921 followed.

In 1922 it joined Ukraine, Belarus and the Transcaucasian republic to form the Soviet Union, and it was by far the largest part. By 1930 Stalin ruled, and collectivisation was forcing peasants into collective farms, at enormous human cost. The republic lasted until 1991, when it became the Russian Federation.
